description.en: Enhanced telemetry for the Trueforce For All SimHub plugin: per-wheel suspension and ground contact, steering, and engine load at up to 100 Hz, so the plugin can render terrain and load in the wheel's force feedback. Keep the SimHub Telemetry Interface mod installed too; this one adds the enhanced channel.
description.de: Erweiterte Telemetrie fuer das Trueforce For All SimHub-Plugin.
